findings.title: Wizard rewrites encryption migration into DROP COLUMN and runs it, destroying existing plaintext data
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The wizard selects populated columns, the rewriter drops the original column with no data copy, and the migrate prompt defaults to yes.

findings.title: Changed Drizzle type string turns existing encrypted columns into ALTERs that the rewrite converts to DROP of ciphertext
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Assumes drizzle-kit emits a clean ALTER to "public"."eql_v2_encrypted" that the rewriter matches; the pre-quoted type is actually mis-rendered, so the claimed DROP-of-ciphertext chain is speculative and not shown by the code.

findings.title: `db install` in Drizzle projects silently stops installing EQL and edits migration files instead
findings.label: valid
findings.note: resolveProviderOptions auto-enables drizzle with no way to negate it via parseArgs, and the drizzle path returns after writing a migration without installing EQL.

findings.title: New .env.local precedence points db commands at a different database
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The new env-file load order lets .env.local's DATABASE_URL override .env's, retargeting db commands.

findings.title: Shipped skills and the stack README still instruct the removed `db setup`
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The bundled skill and README still reference db setup, which now hits the unknown-subcommand path.
